title: Genius: A Generalizable and Purely Unsupervised Self-Training Framework For Advanced Reasoning
authors_zh: Fangzhi Xu、Hang Yan、Chang Ma、Haiteng Zhao、Qiushi Sun、Kanzhi Cheng、Junxian He、Jun Liu、Zhiyong Wu
paper_type_zh: 无监督自我训练与步骤级偏好构造方法
best_for_zh: 研究推理数据构造、自奖励、步骤级偏好学习与数据审计的读者
one_line: Genius converts general queries into same-policy foresight-ranked trajectory pairs for ACO, but the score is not a correctness verifier and the exact preference data is not released.
Genius 将通用查询转换为由同一策略的未来 continuation 分数排序的步骤级轨迹偏好并用于 ACO；该分数不是正确性 verifier，完整偏好数据也未发布。
why: It exposes a label-free construction path from queries to step-local preferences and a policy checkpoint, while showing why lineage, proxy validation, code-version pinning, and rejected-sample retention are necessary for reasoning-data reuse.
inclusion_reason: Genius is a concrete open recipe for turning general queries into policy-internal step-level preferences without an answer label or auxiliary verifier, while its release gaps and code-path mismatches make it an instructive audit case.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official ACL Anthology record identifies this work as an ACL 2025 long paper (July 2025, pages 13153–13167; DOI 10.18653/v1/2025.acl-long.644). It asks a narrow construction question: can a language model turn general natural-language queries into useful reasoning-training records when no answer label, execution environment, human preference, stronger teacher, or auxiliary reward model is available? Existing self-training can cheaply generate responses, but selection becomes underdetermined when no outside system can say which complete answer—or which intermediate step—is correct. (Paper §1)

Genius addresses this gap with a policy-internal value proxy. At each response prefix, the current policy samples candidate next steps and future continuations, converts continuation log probabilities into foresight scores, keeps paths by score-based sampling, and constructs positive/negative trajectory pairs with advantage weights. The resulting training object is not merely “a chain of thought”: it links a source query and policy checkpoint to a prefix, candidate set, future-rollout pool, normalized log probabilities, selected beam, chosen and rejected trajectories, and their advantage values. The official constructor serializes the final preference view as prompt, chosen, rejected, chosen_weights, rejected_weights, and chosen_average_weights. (Paper §2.2; official repository: foresight-sampling/)

This makes the paper directly relevant to the Data Construction and Open Release Recipes category: it specifies a query-to-preference-to-checkpoint pipeline and publishes sampling, preference-construction, and ACO-training code. The adjacent problem it does not solve is semantic verification. Its score observes how probable a continuation is under the same policy; it does not observe a reference answer, test result, proof state, human judgment, or external correctness signal. “Purely unsupervised” therefore describes the absence of external labels in the Genius loop, not proof that the selected branch is correct.

The Card reaches L4 because the ACL paper, full appendices, official repository, two model repositories, and two source-query repositories expose enough detail to reconstruct the intended modules and audit the feedback contract. The evidence boundary remains material: the exact 25K/32K query manifests, the reported 100K/128K preference snapshots, rejected-sample manifests, immutable experiment revision, item-level decontamination, and a complete license chain were not verified as released.

ACL Anthology 官方记录将该工作列为 ACL 2025 长文（2025 年 7 月，第 13153–13167 页；DOI 10.18653/v1/2025.acl-long.644）。论文研究的是一个边界明确的数据构造问题：在没有答案标签、执行环境、人类偏好、更强 teacher 或辅助 reward model 时，语言模型能否把通用自然语言查询转化为有用的推理训练记录？自我训练可以低成本生成回答，但若没有外部系统判断完整答案或中间步骤是否正确，样本选择就缺少确定依据。（论文 §1）

Genius 使用策略内部的价值代理处理这一缺口。在每个回答前缀处，当前 policy 采样候选下一步和未来 continuation，把 continuation 的 log probability 转化为 foresight score，按分数分布采样保留路径，并构造带 advantage 权重的 positive/negative 轨迹对。因此，训练对象不只是“一条 chain of thought”，而是把源查询和 policy checkpoint 与前缀、候选集、未来 rollout 池、归一化 log probability、所选 beam、chosen/rejected 轨迹及其 advantage 值连接起来。官方构造脚本把最终偏好视图序列化为 prompt、chosen、rejected、chosen_weights、rejected_weights 和 chosen_average_weights。（论文 §2.2；官方仓库：foresight-sampling/）

这使论文直接属于 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes 类别：它给出了从查询到偏好再到 checkpoint 的流水线，并公开采样、偏好构造和 ACO 训练代码。它没有解决的相邻问题是语义正确性验证。该分数只能观察同一 policy 认为 continuation 有多大概率；它看不到 reference answer、测试结果、proof state、人类判断或外部正确性信号。因此，“purely unsupervised”表示 Genius 循环没有使用外部标签，而不表示所选分支已经被证明正确。

本卡达到 L4，是因为 ACL 论文、完整附录、官方仓库、两个模型仓库和两个源查询仓库提供了足够信息，可以重建预期模块并审计反馈契约。但证据边界仍然重要：未核验到精确的 25K/32K 查询清单、论文所报 100K/128K 偏好快照、rejected-sample 清单、不可变实验版本、逐条去污染结果或完整许可证链。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
In one sentence, Genius turns a model’s own non-myopic continuation likelihood into weighted step-local trajectory preferences, then trains the model with Advantage-Calibrated Optimization (ACO). For a query and current response prefix, the policy maintains a beam of paths, samples candidate next steps, and generates a future continuation after each candidate. The average token log probability of that future is the foresight score. Normalized scores define a distribution used twice: sampling from it preserves multiple paths for exploration, while the highest-scoring path and a re-sampled alternative form a preference for exploitation. Each path’s advantage is its foresight value minus the value carried from the preceding step. (Paper §2.2)

The feedback contract is entirely policy-internal. It observes token probabilities for same-policy continuations, relative values between the current and previous decision, and which trajectories the search scaffold retained. It cannot observe whether a mathematical conclusion is true, code executes, a logical inference is valid, or a user would prefer the result. The supervision attaches locally at each decision but compares complete trajectories extending that decision; it is therefore both step-level and trajectory-valued. ACO then uses the chosen/rejected advantage gap to relax optimization when the nominal negative appears to have greater estimated advantage. It calibrates the strength of a noisy preference but adds no new correctness information. (Paper §2.3 and Appendix A)

The reusable record is concrete in the official code. The exploration stage can save question, a copied input ground_truth, the selected response, response_all_beams, traj_pool, step_pool, prob_pool, adv_pool, step_prob, and sample_id_pool. The preference constructor reduces that process state to prompt, assistant-message lists for chosen and rejected, their weights, and an average chosen weight. This reduction matters for audit: a final pair alone does not reveal the alternatives, random rejected-path draw, scoring distribution, or policy revision that created it.

The closest comparisons clarify the direction. Self-Rewarding has the model assign response-level 1–5 judgments; ScPO derives response preferences from self-consistency; step-level methods can remain myopic; MCTS-style rewarding adds more expensive backtracking; and the authors’ related φ-Decoding work uses foresight for inference-time exploration. Genius combines foresight with training-data construction and ACO. Candidate generation, beam search, DPO-style implicit rewards, and future simulation are inherited ingredients; the specific change is to make future-continuation likelihood the step-local selection interface for a label-free preference dataset.

一句话概括，Genius 把模型自身的非短视 continuation likelihood 转换成带权的步骤局部轨迹偏好，再用 Advantage-Calibrated Optimization（ACO）训练模型。对于一个查询和当前回答前缀，policy 维护多个路径的 beam，采样候选下一步，并在每个候选之后生成未来 continuation；该未来部分的平均 token log probability 就是 foresight score。归一化后的分数分布有两种用途：从中采样以保留多条探索路径，同时把最高分路径与一个重新采样的备选路径组成 exploitation 偏好。每条路径的 advantage 等于其 foresight value 减去前一步携带的 value。（论文 §2.2）

反馈契约完全位于 policy 内部。它能观察同一 policy 的 continuation token probability、当前决策相对前一决策的 value，以及搜索框架保留了哪些轨迹；它不能观察数学结论是否真实、代码能否执行、逻辑推断是否有效，或用户是否偏好结果。监督在每个决策位置局部附着，但比较的是从该位置延伸出的完整轨迹，因此同时具有 step-level 和 trajectory-valued 特征。随后，ACO 用 chosen/rejected 的 advantage 差调节优化：若名义上的 negative 具有更高估计 advantage，就减弱惩罚。它校准的是噪声偏好的强度，并没有加入新的正确性信息。（论文 §2.3 与 Appendix A）

官方代码把可复用记录定义得更具体。探索阶段可以保存 question、从输入复制的 ground_truth、所选 response、response_all_beams、traj_pool、step_pool、prob_pool、adv_pool、step_prob 和 sample_id_pool。偏好构造器把这些过程状态压缩成 prompt、作为 assistant message 列表的 chosen 与 rejected、二者权重以及 chosen 平均权重。这个压缩过程对审计很关键：只有最终 pair 时，无法看到其他候选、随机抽取 rejected path 的过程、完整分数分布或生成它的 policy revision。

与最接近的方法对比可以说明其方向。Self-Rewarding 让模型给完整回答打 1–5 分；ScPO 从 self-consistency 构造回答偏好；步骤级方法可能仍然短视；MCTS-style rewarding 需要成本更高的回溯；作者相关的 φ-Decoding 则把 foresight 用于推理时探索。Genius 把 foresight 与训练数据构造、ACO 结合起来。候选生成、beam search、DPO-style implicit reward 和 future simulation 都不是新组件；真正改变的是把未来 continuation likelihood 变成无标签偏好数据的步骤局部选择接口。

title: Method
方法
html:
The intended pipeline is source record → query selection → stepwise policy exploration → same-policy foresight scoring → beam sampling and preference re-sampling → weighted preference JSONL → ACO training → checkpoint evaluation.

Inputs and source selection. The paper randomly selects 25K queries from Magpie and 32K from OpenHermes-2.5 and runs the two sources separately. Main experiments use LLaMA3.1-8B-Instruct; Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct are transfer backbones. The official HF source repositories contain instruction and response fields plus provenance metadata. The released sampler requires both fields and copies response to ground_truth, but the visible candidate selection and scoring path uses the instruction and model probabilities, not that copied value. Exact selected IDs are unavailable. (Paper §3.1; official HF viewers and sampling script)

Exploration and self-reward. At each of four decision steps, Genius keeps two beams. For each beam it samples four candidate next steps at generation temperature 0.6, then generates a future continuation for each candidate. It divides cumulative continuation log probability by continuation length to produce a foresight value, normalizes candidate values, and samples two paths without replacement for the next decision. The paper describes the normalized distribution abstractly; the released script uses softmax temperature 0.1, seed 0 by default, candidate maximum length 1024, and a final completion budget of 3000 tokens. The score is not checked against task outcomes. (Paper §2.2, §3.1, Appendix B.2; official sampler)

Preference construction. At each decision, the highest-foresight trajectory is chosen and a lower-ranked trajectory is sampled as rejected. Advantages subtract the previous path value. The paper keeps four pairs per query, so the two runs contain 100K and 128K pairs. The official constructor sorts candidates by stored log probability, picks the top trajectory, randomly chooses one of the rest with seed 42, and writes prompt, chosen, rejected, chosen_weights, rejected_weights, and chosen_average_weights. The full process pools are necessary if another lab wants to recompute the pair or change the selection rule.

Optimization. ACO uses a policy and reference model as in DPO, but scales the rejected log-ratio using the chosen/rejected advantage difference. The paper reports 8 A100 80GB GPUs, DeepSpeed ZeRO-3, FlashAttention2, total batch size 128, learning rate 5e-7, and alpha=1. The released command additionally sets one epoch, warmup ratio 0.1, maximum sequence length 1300, and uses the parser default beta=0.1; its model, train-file, and output paths are blank. Sampling used 32 A100 80GB GPUs with vLLM. Software versions, paper-run seeds, wall-clock cost, and exact checkpoint hashes are not disclosed. (Appendix B.2; official training script)

Evaluation and contamination boundary. Inference uses vLLM at temperature 1.0, with 4-shot GSM8K, 8-shot MATH, and zero-shot evaluation elsewhere. The main reasoning suite covers GSM8K, MATH, ReClor, LogiQA, StrategyQA, GPQA, and ARC-Challenge; additional surfaces include six general benchmarks, AIME 2024, MBPP, and LiveCodeBench. Appendix C compares embedding distributions with t-SNE and average distances over 500 samples per dataset, but does not disclose item-level deduplication, benchmark-overlap removal, or immutable train/evaluation manifests.

Released-code checks required before reproduction. On the inspected unpinned main branch, the sampler allocates traj_pool, prob_pool, and adv_pool with num_foresight+1 slots but step_prob with num_foresight slots; the constructor skips a record unless all four lengths are equal. It also stores prompt separately, while the shown ACO encoder reads only the chosen and rejected message lists. These are curator-observed handoff risks, not author-reported experimental failures. A reproduction should pin a revision, resolve both paths, confirm query conditioning, retain rejected candidates and process pools, and publish the exact selected-source and preference manifests.

预期流水线是 源记录 → 查询选择 → policy 分步探索 → 同策略 foresight 打分 → beam 采样与偏好重采样 → 带权偏好 JSONL → ACO 训练 → checkpoint 评测。

输入与来源选择。 论文从 Magpie 随机选择 25K 查询，从 OpenHermes-2.5 随机选择 32K 查询，并分别运行两个来源。主实验使用 LLaMA3.1-8B-Instruct，迁移实验的 backbone 为 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct。官方 HF 源仓库包含 instruction、response 和来源元数据。发布的采样器要求两者都存在，并把 response 复制到 ground_truth；但可见的候选选择与打分路径只使用 instruction 和模型概率，没有使用该复制值。精确的入选 ID 未发布。（论文 §3.1；官方 HF viewer 与采样脚本）

探索与自奖励。 在四个决策步骤中的每一步，Genius 保留两个 beam。每个 beam 以生成温度 0.6 采样四个候选下一步，再为每个候选生成一个未来 continuation。方法用 continuation 的累计 log probability 除以其 token 长度得到 foresight value，将候选 value 归一化，并无放回采样两条路径进入下一决策。论文抽象描述了归一化分布；发布脚本使用 softmax 温度 0.1，默认 seed 为 0，候选最大长度为 1024，最终 completion 预算为 3000 tokens。该分数不与任务结果核对。（论文 §2.2、§3.1、Appendix B.2；官方采样器）

偏好构造。 每个决策位置把 foresight 最高的轨迹作为 chosen，并从较低排名轨迹中抽取 rejected。Advantage 由当前值减去前一路径值。论文每个查询保留四个 pair，因此两个实验分别包含 100K 和 128K pair。官方构造器按所存 log probability 对候选排序，选择最高分轨迹，再以 seed 42 从其余轨迹随机选一条，写出 prompt、chosen、rejected、chosen_weights、rejected_weights 和 chosen_average_weights。若要重算 pair 或更换选择规则，必须保留完整过程池。

优化。 ACO 与 DPO 一样使用 policy 和 reference model，但根据 chosen/rejected 的 advantage 差缩放 rejected log-ratio。论文报告使用 8 张 A100 80GB、DeepSpeed ZeRO-3、FlashAttention2、总 batch size 128、learning rate 5e-7 和 alpha=1。发布命令还设置 1 epoch、warmup ratio 0.1、maximum sequence length 1300，并采用解析器默认的 beta=0.1；但 model、train-file 和 output path 仍为空。采样阶段使用 32 张 A100 80GB 与 vLLM。软件版本、论文实验 seed、wall-clock 成本和精确 checkpoint hash 均未披露。（Appendix B.2；官方训练脚本）

评测与污染边界。 推理使用 vLLM、温度 1.0；GSM8K 为 4-shot，MATH 为 8-shot，其他评测为 zero-shot。主推理套件包括 GSM8K、MATH、ReClor、LogiQA、StrategyQA、GPQA 和 ARC-Challenge；其他评测面包括六个通用 benchmark、AIME 2024、MBPP 与 LiveCodeBench。Appendix C 使用 t-SNE 和每个数据集 500 个样本的平均距离比较 embedding 分布，但没有披露逐条 deduplication、benchmark-overlap 清除或不可变的训练/评测清单。

复现前必须检查的发布代码。 在本次检查的未固定 main 分支上，采样器为 traj_pool、prob_pool 和 adv_pool 分配 num_foresight+1 个槽位，却只为 step_prob 分配 num_foresight 个槽位；构造器则要求四者长度相等，否则跳过该记录。它还把 prompt 单独保存，而展示的 ACO encoder 只读取 chosen 和 rejected message list。这些是 curator 对交接路径的观察，不是作者报告的实验失败。复现时应固定 revision，解决这两条路径，确认查询确实进入训练上下文，保留 rejected candidates 和过程池，并发布精确的源选择与偏好清单。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Under the paper’s LLaMA3.1-8B-Instruct setup, the seven-benchmark reasoning average rises from 49.65 for the base model to 57.08 after Genius training on Magpie-25K and 56.90 after training on OpenHermes-2.5-32K. The strongest unsupervised baseline in the corresponding Table 1 blocks reaches 54.45 and 54.26, respectively. Individual scores are not uniformly large gains: for example, Magpie Genius reports 34.64 on MATH and 30.35 on GPQA, while OpenHermes Genius reports 34.42 and 34.82. These are author-reported model results, not measurements of per-pair correctness. (Paper Table 1)

The component evidence is more diagnostic. Removing foresight lowers the average from 57.08 to 53.91 for Magpie and from 56.90 to 53.65 for OpenHermes (−3.17 and −3.25 points). Replacing score-distribution sampling with the paper’s greedy variant gives 52.98 and 53.80 (−4.10 and −3.10). With foresight data held fixed, ACO scores 57.08/56.90 versus DPO 55.51/55.73 and ROPO 55.30/55.25. These ablations support the tested search and weighting choices jointly with the rest of the implementation; they do not calibrate foresight as correctness probability or establish universal ACO superiority. (Tables 3–4)

General-domain and code results are mixed enough to constrain interpretation. Table 2 reports Arena-Hard increasing from 30.31 to 50.00 for both Genius variants, but Magpie MMLU-Pro changes from 48.62 to 48.44 and OpenHermes WikiBench from 27.65 to 27.00. Appendix D reports MBPP 69.65→71.60/71.98 and LiveCodeBench 19.50→19.75/21.25 for Magpie/OpenHermes. Figure 5 reports a 6.67-point AIME 2024 improvement for the tested checkpoints, while Figure 6 contains only 10K-level down-sampled training curves and the authors explicitly cite compute limits. (Table 2, Figure 5, §4.2, Appendix D Table 6)

Artifact evidence supports partial reproducibility. The official repository exposes the sampling, preference-construction, ACO-training, and evaluation code; the official HF collection exposes two LLaMA3.1-8B-Instruct checkpoints and two source-query datasets. Both model pages and both source-dataset pages declare Apache-2.0. However, the collection does not expose a verified 100K/128K generated preference snapshot, and GitHub shows no tagged release. The visible quick-start code also has process-array length and prompt-conditioning handoff questions documented in this Card.

No independent reproduction was identified in the confirmed artifacts. Appendix C’s embedding-distance analysis shows that the sampled source-query embeddings differ on average from the benchmark embeddings, but it is not an item-level contamination test. Consequently, the strongest supported conclusion is that the authors report gains and informative ablations under their setup and publish substantial implementation surfaces—not that every constructed preference is correct, calibrated, uncontaminated, or directly reusable.

在论文的 LLaMA3.1-8B-Instruct 设置下，七个 benchmark 的推理平均分从 base model 的 49.65 提升到 Magpie-25K 训练后的 57.08，以及 OpenHermes-2.5-32K 训练后的 56.90。Table 1 相应分块中最强的无监督 baseline 分别为 54.45 和 54.26。单项结果并不都是同等幅度的提升：例如，Magpie Genius 在 MATH 和 GPQA 上分别为 34.64、30.35，OpenHermes Genius 则为 34.42、34.82。这些是作者报告的模型结果，不是逐个 preference pair 的正确性测量。（论文 Table 1）

组件证据更有诊断价值。移除 foresight 后，Magpie 平均分从 57.08 降到 53.91，OpenHermes 从 56.90 降到 53.65，分别下降 3.17 和 3.25 分。把按分数分布采样替换为论文定义的 greedy 变体后，结果为 52.98 和 53.80，分别下降 4.10 和 3.10 分。在 foresight 数据固定时，ACO 为 57.08/56.90，DPO 为 55.51/55.73，ROPO 为 55.30/55.25。这些消融支持受测搜索与加权选择和其余实现的组合，但不能把 foresight 校准成正确概率，也不能证明 ACO 普遍优于其他目标。（Tables 3–4）

通用域和代码结果呈现出足以限制解释的混合现象。Table 2 报告两个 Genius 变体的 Arena-Hard 都从 30.31 升到 50.00，但 Magpie 的 MMLU-Pro 从 48.62 变为 48.44，OpenHermes 的 WikiBench 从 27.65 变为 27.00。Appendix D 报告 MBPP 从 69.65 升到 71.60/71.98，LiveCodeBench 从 19.50 升到 19.75/21.25。Figure 5 对受测 checkpoint 报告 AIME 2024 提升 6.67 分；Figure 6 只有 10K 量级的下采样训练曲线，作者也明确说明受到计算资源限制。（Table 2、Figure 5、§4.2、Appendix D Table 6）

Artifact 证据只支持部分复现。官方仓库公开了采样、偏好构造、ACO 训练和评测代码；官方 HF collection 公开了两个 LLaMA3.1-8B-Instruct checkpoint 和两个源查询数据集。两个模型页和两个源数据集页都声明 Apache-2.0。但 collection 没有提供经核验的 100K/128K 生成偏好快照，GitHub 也没有 tagged release；可见 quick-start 代码还存在本卡记录的过程数组长度与 prompt conditioning 交接问题。

在已确认 artifact 中没有找到独立复现。Appendix C 的 embedding-distance 分析显示源查询样本与 benchmark embedding 在平均意义上不同，但它不是逐条污染检测。因此，最强的有证据结论是：作者在其设置下报告了性能增益和有信息量的消融，并公开了相当一部分实现界面；这不等于每条构造偏好都正确、已校准、无污染或可直接复用。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline is not “no self-training.” STaR-style methods already bootstrap on self-generated solutions, Self-Rewarding uses the model as a response-level judge, ScPO derives preferences from self-consistency, step-level preference methods construct local supervision, and search methods use future simulation or backtracking. The authors’ related φ-Decoding work also uses foresight to balance inference-time exploration and exploitation. Genius reassembles these ingredients around a different data boundary: general queries enter without an external outcome label, and same-policy future likelihood supplies a value for each local branch. (Paper §1, §5, Appendix B.1)

The concrete change has three parts. First, it materializes future continuations and length-normalized log probabilities at each response decision instead of judging only the final answer. Second, the same normalized foresight distribution drives both next-beam exploration and chosen/rejected trajectory construction. Third, ACO carries the estimated advantage gap into optimization rather than treating all synthetic preferences as equally trustworthy. The resulting release-oriented object is a provenance-rich weighted trajectory pair, not an answer-only rejection-sampling record.

What is not new should remain visible. Beam search, autoregressive sampling, future rollout, DPO’s policy/reference log-ratio, preference pairs, and self-training all predate Genius. The paper does not introduce an external verifier, a new execution environment, a correctness-labeled process dataset, or a demonstrated contamination-control method. Its evidence is an integration and ablation claim: in the tested model/data setting, foresight sampling and advantage-aware weighting improve the final benchmark averages relative to the named alternatives.

The direction signal for reasoning-data research is the attempt to manufacture supervision where only prompts and a policy are available. That makes the method useful for testing how far a policy-internal proxy can substitute for labels, but it also collapses generator, search policy, and evaluator into the same error source. Before reuse, a lab should compare the foresight ranking with an independent verifier on a labeled audit subset, test score calibration across checkpoints and lengths, preserve all rejected branches, and repair or explain the released code handoff. Without those checks, scale alone could amplify a stable proxy error.

既有工作的基线并不是“没有自我训练”。STaR-style 方法已经利用自生成解进行 bootstrapping，Self-Rewarding 让模型充当回答级 judge，ScPO 从 self-consistency 构造偏好，步骤级偏好方法会构造局部监督，搜索方法也使用未来模拟或回溯。作者相关的 φ-Decoding 工作还使用 foresight 平衡推理时的 exploration 与 exploitation。Genius 围绕不同的数据边界重新组合这些组件：输入是没有外部 outcome label 的通用查询，同一 policy 的未来 likelihood 为每个局部分支提供 value。（论文 §1、§5、Appendix B.1）

具体变化有三部分。第一，它在每个回答决策位置物化未来 continuation 及其长度归一化 log probability，而不是只判断最终答案。第二，同一个归一化 foresight 分布既驱动下一轮 beam 探索，也驱动 chosen/rejected 轨迹构造。第三，ACO 把估计的 advantage gap 带入优化，而不是假定所有合成偏好同样可信。由此得到的、面向发布的数据对象应是一条保留来源信息的带权轨迹对，而不是只含答案的 rejection-sampling 记录。

哪些部分并非新方法也应明确保留。Beam search、自回归采样、future rollout、DPO 的 policy/reference log-ratio、preference pair 和自我训练都早于 Genius。论文没有引入外部 verifier、新的执行环境、带正确性标签的过程数据集，或经过验证的污染控制方法。其证据是组合与消融层面的主张：在受测模型和数据设置下，foresight sampling 与 advantage-aware weighting 相比具名方法提高了最终 benchmark 平均分。

该工作对推理数据研究的方向意义，是尝试在只有 prompts 和 policy 时制造监督。这使它适合检验 policy-internal proxy 在多大程度上可以替代标签，但也把 generator、search policy 和 evaluator 合并为同一误差来源。复用前，应在带标签审计子集上将 foresight ranking 与独立 verifier 对比，测试分数跨 checkpoint 与长度的校准，保存全部 rejected branch，并修复或解释发布代码的交接问题。缺少这些检查时，扩大规模可能只会放大稳定的代理误差。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The primary modeling limitation is the gap between likelihood and correctness. The foresight score measures how probable a same-policy continuation is after a candidate step. A confidently repeated misconception may therefore receive a high score, while a valid but unfamiliar or branching argument may receive a low score. This creates both false positives and false negatives. The paper reports downstream ablations, but no labeled study of step-ranking accuracy, calibration, abstention, or adversarially constructed branches. (Curator inference from the feedback contract)

The continuations are correlated evidence. They share the same model, prefix, tokenizer, decoding code, and learned biases; four rollouts per beam are not independent votes. Local score-based decisions can discard a globally useful path, and training can shift the policy toward prefixes that make its own future generations more probable rather than more semantically correct. ACO relaxes the influence of inconsistent estimated advantages, but it cannot manufacture correctness information that is absent from the proxy. Cross-policy and cross-checkpoint transfer of the ranking remains untested. (Curator inference; Paper §2.2–2.3)

The released implementation has unresolved reproducibility risks. On the inspected unpinned main, the exploration script creates three process pools with five slots when num_foresight=4 but creates step_prob with four; the preference constructor’s equality guard would skip such a record. The constructor also keeps prompt outside the chosen/rejected message lists, while the shown training encoder consumes those message lists and not the separate prompt field. These observations may reflect code drift or a missing preprocessing step, so they should be reproduced before being labeled definitive defects. The training shell retains blank paths, and no tagged release binds it to the paper runs.

Data and release lineage are incomplete. The HF collection exposes 150K Magpie and 48K OpenHermes source repositories rather than the exact selected 25K/32K manifests, and it does not expose a verified 100K/128K preference snapshot. Source records include responses, which the sampler copies to ground_truth; although the visible selection code does not use that field, a pinned end-to-end audit is needed to rule out label leakage. Rejected candidates, paper-run process pools, pair-level splits, seeds, logs, code/model hashes, and retention policies are unknown. The model and source-data repositories declare Apache-2.0, but code and generated-preference licensing remain unknown.

The contamination and experimental boundaries are also narrow. Appendix C uses embedding visualization and mean distances, not exact overlap detection. Main evidence is concentrated on LLaMA3.1-8B-Instruct, two source mixtures, and named public benchmarks; Qwen transfer is summarized without the full per-task table in the HTML surface. General-domain results include small declines, and the scaling study is limited by compute. Benchmark gains cannot identify which preferences are correct or whether the method remains stable with a new sampler, policy family, language, domain, or larger rollout budget.

首要建模限制是 likelihood 与正确性之间的缺口。Foresight score 衡量候选步骤之后的同策略 continuation 有多大概率。一个被模型自信重复的误解可能得到高分，而正确但陌生、需要分支探索的论证可能得到低分，因此会同时产生 false positive 和 false negative。论文给出了下游消融，但没有报告带标签的步骤排序准确率、calibration、abstention 或对抗分支研究。（基于反馈契约的 curator inference）

这些 continuation 是相关证据。它们共享同一个模型、前缀、tokenizer、解码代码和学习偏差；每个 beam 的四次 rollout 不是独立投票。局部分数决策可能丢弃全局有用路径，训练也可能把 policy 推向“让自己的未来输出更高概率”的前缀，而不是更正确的前缀。ACO 可以减弱 advantage 估计不一致样本的影响，却无法制造代理信号中不存在的正确性信息。排序能否跨 policy 或 checkpoint 迁移仍未测试。（curator inference；论文 §2.2–2.3）

发布实现存在尚未解决的复现风险。在本次检查的未固定 main 上，当 num_foresight=4 时，探索脚本为三个过程池创建五个槽位，却只为 step_prob 创建四个槽位；偏好构造器的长度相等检查会跳过这种记录。构造器还把 prompt 放在 chosen/rejected message list 之外，而展示的训练 encoder 只消费这两个 message list，不读取独立 prompt 字段。这些现象可能来自代码漂移或缺失的预处理步骤，因此复现前不应直接定性为最终缺陷。训练 shell 仍有空路径，也没有 tagged release 将代码绑定到论文实验。

数据与发布谱系不完整。HF collection 提供的是 150K Magpie 和 48K OpenHermes 源仓库，而非精确的 25K/32K 入选清单，也没有提供经核验的 100K/128K 偏好快照。源记录包含 response，采样器会把它复制到 ground_truth；虽然可见选择代码不使用该字段，仍需对固定版本做端到端审计才能排除标签泄漏。Rejected candidates、论文实验过程池、pair-level split、seed、log、代码/模型 hash 和保留策略均未知。模型与源数据仓库声明 Apache-2.0，但代码和生成偏好数据的许可证未知。

污染与实验边界也很窄。Appendix C 使用 embedding 可视化和平均距离，而不是精确重叠检测。主要证据集中在 LLaMA3.1-8B-Instruct、两种来源混合和具名公开 benchmark；Qwen 迁移结果在 HTML 页面中没有完整逐任务表。通用域结果包含小幅下降，scaling 研究也受算力限制。Benchmark 增益无法识别哪些 preference 正确，也不能证明方法在新 sampler、policy family、语言、领域或更大 rollout budget 下仍然稳定。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track, Genius is most useful as a worked schema for label-free preference construction. A reproduction can treat one source query as the root object, preserve every policy prefix and candidate, attach each future continuation and normalized log probability, record beam-selection probabilities and random seeds, and derive chosen/rejected trajectories plus advantage weights. This makes explicit how a policy-internal proxy becomes a training distribution and which information must survive release for that transformation to be audited.

The method also supports controlled comparisons. A lab can hold queries and candidate rollouts fixed while comparing foresight likelihood with an answer checker, unit-test executor, process reward model, independent LLM judge, or human audit subset. It can vary beam size, rollout count, score temperature, continuation length normalization, rejected-path sampling, and ACO versus DPO while measuring both downstream scores and pair-level false positives/false negatives. The paper’s Table 3 and Table 4 provide baseline conditions for those ablations.

As an audit reference, the current release highlights a practical checklist: pin source-dataset IDs and policy hashes; confirm that the query is present in the training messages; separate copied source responses from fields actually used by the algorithm; retain full process pools and failures; record pair lineage and selection probability; test for item-level benchmark overlap; publish software/hardware configuration; and license code, source data, generated preferences, and checkpoints separately. The visible array-length guard is also a useful end-to-end smoke test for any reimplementation.

Reuse class: blocked pending verification for direct training-data reuse because the paper-run 100K/128K preference snapshots, exact source manifests, and immutable end-to-end recipe are unavailable. The official code and checkpoints are suitable for reading/audit reference and reproduction-oriented experiments after the handoff issues are resolved. The HF source datasets should not be mislabeled as the generated Genius preference data, and the benchmark results should not be used as a substitute for record-level quality validation.

对于 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes 赛道，Genius 最有用的地方是提供一个无标签偏好构造的完整 schema。复现者可以把一条源查询作为根对象，保存每个 policy 前缀与候选，附上每条未来 continuation 及其归一化 log probability，记录 beam 选择概率与随机 seed，再派生 chosen/rejected 轨迹和 advantage 权重。这样可以明确看到 policy-internal proxy 如何变成训练分布，以及为了审计这一转换，发布时必须保留哪些信息。

该方法也适合受控对比。实验室可以固定查询和候选 rollout，比较 foresight likelihood 与 answer checker、unit-test executor、process reward model、独立 LLM judge 或人工审计子集；还可以改变 beam size、rollout count、分数温度、continuation 长度归一化、rejected-path 采样，以及 ACO 与 DPO，同时测量下游分数和 pair-level false positive/false negative。论文 Table 3 和 Table 4 为这些消融提供了基线条件。

作为审计参考，当前发布揭示了一份实用清单：固定源数据 ID 和 policy hash；确认查询进入训练 message；区分从源数据复制的 response 与算法实际使用的字段；保存完整过程池和失败样本；记录 pair lineage 与选择概率；做逐条 benchmark overlap 检查；发布软件/硬件配置；并分别说明代码、源数据、生成偏好和 checkpoint 的许可证。可见的数组长度 guard 也可以作为重实现的端到端 smoke test。

复用等级：由于论文实验的 100K/128K 偏好快照、精确来源清单和不可变端到端配方均不可用，直接训练数据复用被阻塞，等待核验。在解决交接问题后，官方代码和 checkpoint 适合用作阅读/审计参考与面向复现的实验起点。HF 源数据集不能被误标为 Genius 生成偏好数据，benchmark 结果也不能替代逐条数据质量验证。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §2.2 before the score tables: the foresight signal is length-normalized same-policy continuation log probability, not an external correctness verifier.
  • Keep the units separate: 25K/32K source queries, four pairs per query, 100K/128K reported preferences, two beams, four rollouts per beam, and four foresight steps.
  • Use Tables 3–4 for mechanism evidence: removing foresight costs 3.17/3.25 average points, greedy sampling costs 4.10/3.10, and ACO exceeds the tested DPO and ROPO objectives under fixed foresight data.
  • Do not confuse the HF collection’s two source-query datasets and two checkpoints with a release of the exact generated preference snapshots.
  • Before reproduction, inspect the official sampler/constructor length guard, verify that prompt conditions ACO training, pin revisions and manifests, and read Appendix C as embedding analysis rather than decontamination proof.

• 阅读分数表前先看 §2.2：foresight 信号是长度归一化的同策略 continuation log probability，不是外部正确性 verifier。
  • 区分各计量单位：25K/32K 源查询、每个查询四个 pair、论文报告的 100K/128K 偏好、两个 beam、每个 beam 四次 rollout，以及四个 foresight step。
  • 用 Tables 3–4 判断机制证据：移除 foresight 后平均分下降 3.17/3.25，greedy sampling 下降 4.10/3.10；在 foresight 数据固定时，ACO 高于受测 DPO 和 ROPO 目标。
  • 不要把 HF collection 中两个源查询数据集和两个 checkpoint 误认为精确生成偏好快照已经发布。
  • 复现前检查官方 sampler/constructor 的长度 guard，确认 prompt 确实作为 ACO 训练条件，固定 revision 与 manifest，并把 Appendix C 视为 embedding 分析而非去污染证明。

value.html: The paper randomly selects 25K queries from Magpie and 32K queries from OpenHermes-2.5 for separate self-training runs. Exact selected item manifests and immutable source revisions are unknown. The official HF source repositories contain instruction-response records, although the method claims to consume only the queries.

The paper describes a step-local quintuple consisting of the current context, positive and negative trajectories, and their advantage information. The official constructor emits JSONL fields prompt, chosen, rejected, chosen_weights, rejected_weights, and chosen_average_weights; the chosen and rejected values are assistant-message lists containing complete sampled trajectories.

The current policy model proposes candidate next steps, generates same-policy future continuations, selects paths, and supplies the log-probability-derived value proxy. Main experiments use LLaMA3.1-8B-Instruct; Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct appear in transfer experiments.

items: selected final response and all retained beams

value.html: Offline natural-language generation with vLLM; there is no task executor, answer checker, human judge, or external reward model in the construction loop.

A candidate's foresight score is the length-normalized cumulative log probability of a same-policy future continuation. Scores define a sampling distribution, and advantages subtract the preceding step value. This is a policy-internal trajectory-value proxy, not a calibrated probability of correctness.
No external correctness predicate is applied. Path selection stops through the generation scaffold, and preference labels come from relative foresight scores.
LLaMA3.1-8B-Instruct in the main experiments; Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct in transfer experiments.
No external teacher in the Genius construction loop; the current policy generates candidates, future continuations, and the value proxy.
Stepwise beam exploration followed by future-continuation simulation, foresight-score sampling, preference re-sampling, and ACO training.

Paper setup: step beam size 2, four rollouts per beam, four foresight steps, generation temperature 0.6. The released sampler uses seed 0 by default and a hard-coded softmax temperature of 0.1 for foresight selection; the preference constructor seeds rejected-path sampling with 42.

Retain next-step beams by sampling from the normalized foresight-score distribution. For exploitation, take the highest-scoring trajectory as chosen and re-sample a rejected trajectory from the remaining candidates; attach advantage values relative to the preceding step.
Paper sampling used 32 A100 80GB GPUs with vLLM. The authors keep four preference pairs per query, producing 100K pairs from 25K Magpie queries and 128K pairs from 32K OpenHermes-2.5 queries.

Advantage-Calibrated Optimization with a reference model. Paper training used 8 A100 80GB GPUs, DeepSpeed ZeRO-3, FlashAttention2, total batch size 128, learning rate 5e-7, and alpha 1. The released shell shows one epoch, warmup ratio 0.1, maximum sequence length 1300, and default beta 0.1, but leaves model, data, and output paths blank.

Separate Magpie-25K and OpenHermes-2.5-32K query runs with policy-generated candidate steps, future continuations, scores, preferences, and ACO updates. The official source repositories also expose responses and upstream generator metadata that the paper does not claim to use as supervision.

The paper reports random 25K/32K selections and 100K/128K constructed training pairs. Exact selected IDs, train/validation manifests, pair-level splits, and the mapping from paper runs to released checkpoints are unknown.
unknown. Appendix C visualizes t-SNE distributions and embedding distances for 500 samples per dataset, but reports no item-level deduplication or benchmark decontamination procedure.

Source records include responses copied to an output ground_truth field, requiring an end-to-end leakage audit
Exact pair snapshots, rejected-sample manifests, code revision, decontamination, and full license chain are unavailable
